'''Romor''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. She was the [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] on duty in the [[Halls of Healing]] during [[Valin Horn]]'s escape from the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Horn knocked her out before taking her lightsaber and leaving. Romor had a concussion but would recover soon.
